ai_leverage: Generate candidates and map adjacent literatures
human_responsibility: Define what matters, who is affected, and why the question is worth scarce attention
required_evidence: Stakeholder relevance and a defensible gap
failure_risk: Novelty theatre or a stream of small variations
priority_action: Keep a problem portfolio tied to named decisions and unresolved questions

ai_leverage: Offer rival explanations and formalise assumptions
human_responsibility: Select the mechanism, specify boundary conditions, and accept responsibility for interpretation
required_evidence: Transparent assumptions and tests against rival explanations
priority_action: Write the best alternative explanation before the main hypothesis

ai_leverage: Find sources, extract fields, reconcile formats, and write parsers
human_responsibility: Establish rights, provenance, coverage, and whether the data represent the target setting
required_evidence: Source agreement, missingness, and permission to use
failure_risk: Unrepresentative, confidential, or illegally obtained data
priority_action: Maintain a data dictionary and rights log from day one

ai_leverage: Propose identification strategies and simulate power
human_responsibility: Own the estimand, selecting assumptions, and limits of causal language
failure_risk: False certainty or an uninterpretable model
priority_action: Use a design review before producing results

ai_leverage: Generate code, tests, documentation, and alternative specifications
human_responsibility: Verify independently, inspect edge cases, and decide when the model is fit for use
failure_risk: Hidden bugs and silent data errors
priority_action: Never accept code that cannot be rerun from a clean environment

ai_leverage: Search, cluster, summarise, and identify gaps
human_responsibility: Check every citation, weigh conflicting evidence, and preserve provenance
priority_action: Maintain a source ledger, not a chat transcript

ai_leverage: Outline, draft, edit, and adapt to audiences
human_responsibility: Own the argument, claims, tone, uncertainty, and accountability
required_evidence: Claim-by-claim source checks and human editorial review
priority_action: Use AI to critique a human argument before using it to generate one

ai_leverage: Red-team arguments, find inconsistencies, and propose robustness checks
human_responsibility: Set the evidence threshold and decide whether to revise, narrow, or stop
failure_risk: Model and human sharing the same blind spot
priority_action: Require a second verification method for every important result

human_responsibility: Weigh consequences, institutional context, ethics, and competing values
required_evidence: Explicit judgement criteria and dissenting views
failure_risk: Overconfident advice or hidden value judgements
priority_action: Separate what the evidence shows from what the authors recommend

ai_leverage: Create summaries, briefs, documentation, and update checks
human_responsibility: Build trust with readers and decision makers and keep the record current
priority_action: Treat communication and maintenance as part of the research
